what: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
title: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
text: Calculates tree volume using Sharma-Pukkala stem-volume equations combined Forest Regulation branch-volume ratios /FRTC (2025) stem-volume equations. function automatically distinguishes individual-tree inputs forest inventories according whether plot_id plot_area_ha supplied.

title: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
code: volume(   input,   output = NULL,   sheet = 1,   methods = c("sharma_pukkala", "frtc"),   dbh_breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, Inf) )

title: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
text: input data frame path existing .csv .xlsx file. output Optional .xlsx path exporting results. file inputs, output workbook created automatically omitted. sheet Worksheet read input .xlsx file. Defaults 1. methods One supported volume methods: "sharma_pukkala" "frtc". default calculated. dbh_breaks Breaks used DBH-class summaries plot information supplied.

title: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
text: object class nepal_volume_result. Individual-tree inputs contain tree_results method_audit. Forest-inventory inputs additionally contain forest_summary, plot_summary, species_summary, dbh_class_summary.

title: Estimate individual-tree or forest-inventory volume — volume
text: minimum columns individual-tree volume estimation tree_id, species, dbh_cm, height_m. forest-inventory summaries, plot_id plot_area_ha must also supplied. Optional columns include forest_id, forest_area_ha, branch_group. Sharma-Pukkala + Forest Regulation, total volume stem volume plus branch volume. species requiring generic Forest Regulation branch category, user must explicitly enter other_broadleaf other_conifer; package infer category. FRTC (2025), package returns total stem volume bark, -bark stem volume 20-cm -bark top diameter, -bark stem volume 10-cm -bark top diameter. FRTC volume outputs exclude 30-cm stump exclude branches. Thus, displayed FRTC total volume total stem volume, total tree volume including branches.
